context: A teacher walks a teen through social research
purpose: Teach: 過失/匹敵/八木/出血/究明/受診/遮断/一刻

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、論文、社会的過失、地域社会の影響、論じましたね。
lines.en: Sakura — in your paper, you examined social negligence and its impact on the community very thoroughly.
lines.style: Warm, professional, measured. Slight upward inflection at the name — establishing presence. Steady pace. The tone of a teacher who has actually read the work and wants the student to know it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。被害規模、過去の災害に匹敵するものでした。
lines.en: Yes. The scale of the damage was comparable to past disasters.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slightly formal register — she's speaking about serious subject matter. Steady eye contact without being defensive. Brief, because the evidence speaks.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 八木さんの証言、フィールドワークで、頂きましたね。
lines.en: And you obtained Yagi-san's testimony through your fieldwork.
lines.style: Thoughtful, noting something important. A gentle rise at the end — not quite a question, more like 'I see what you did there.' Slower pace on 'Yagi-san.' Recognition of the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。当時、出血治療の医療制度、まだ、十分ではありませんでした。
lines.en: Yes. At that time, the medical system for treating bleeding injuries was still inadequate.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but weighted. She's describing a gap in care — institutional failure. Not accusatory, but the weight is there. Measured pace. Slight pause before 'inadequate.'

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 真相究明への市民活動、論文の柱でしたね。
lines.en: The citizen activism for truth-seeking became a central pillar of your argument.
lines.style: Reflective, almost wondering. Mid-pace. A note of respect underneath — she's highlighting the spine of the work. Slight lean forward, like she's inviting Sakura to see what she's built.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。被害者の方々、長期にわたり、受診を続けています。
lines.en: Yes. The victims have continued to seek medical care over many years.
lines.style: Steady, quiet. The weight of 'many years' — she lets it land. No rush. This is specific testimony she's chosen to emphasize. Breath support throughout.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時、情報遮断が、社会、混乱に、拍車をかけました。
lines.en: The information blackout at the time accelerated social confusion and mistrust.
lines.style: Analytical, clear-eyed. No blame in the voice — this is institutional observation. Measured pace, each phrase distinct. The teacher thinking aloud with a student she trusts.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。一刻も早い、社会的支援、必要、訴えました、論文で。
lines.en: Yes. In the paper, I argued that social support was needed as soon as possible.
lines.style: Firm closing. Slight acceleration on 'as soon as possible' — urgency without anxiety. Confidence in the argument. The last statement of a larger piece of work — grounded, complete.
